description: This Java source file defines the AutoTest class, which implements a firmware simulator functional test suite for the rusEfi project. It contains multiple test methods for different engine types and configurations, sending commands, and asserting waveforms and sensor values.

classes.name: AutoTest
classes.description: Main class for running firmware simulation tests, containing various test methods for different engine configurations and assertions.

methods.name: mainTestBody
methods.description: Executes the sequence of tests for different engine types and configurations.

methods.name: testCustomEngine
methods.description: Tests custom engine setup commands.

methods.description: Tests Mazda Miata 2003 engine parameters.

methods.name: testCamaro
methods.description: Sets engine type for Camaro.

methods.name: testBmwE34
methods.description: Tests BMW E34 engine waveform and cylinder cycle.

methods.name: testCitroenBerlingo
methods.description: Sets engine type for Citroen Berlingo.
